fillRequired: Please fill in the template name, description, and goal
managerDescription: Templates save the description, goal, category, and task-level intercept/allow rules. Changes do not affect tasks already created.
goalPlaceholder: What the task needs to achieve
categoryDescription: Prefills this category when the template is applied (can be changed).
interceptRulesDescription: These task-level rules are prefilled when the template is applied (intercept/allow; they apply only to new tasks, not globally).
deleteConfirmDescription: Tasks created from this template will not be affected.
searchTemplates: Search and select a task template
applyTemplateNotice: Selecting a template copies its description, goal, category, and task-level rules; the task stays unlinked from the template.
applyTemplateDescription: The description and goal you have already entered will be overwritten by the template content.
